newsitem.title: CHINA: CHENGDU TELECOM SAYS NOT IN RESTRUCTURING.
newsitem.headline: CHENGDU TELECOM SAYS NOT IN RESTRUCTURING.

text.p: Chengdu Telecommunications Cable Co Ltd said on Thursday it was not in talks with its controlling shareholder China National Posts and Telecommunications Industrial Co (PTIC) regarding asset restructuring.
"There are no negotiations or agreements between the company and PTIC or any other third parties in relation to the reorganisation of the assets of the company," the company said in a statement.
The company said it made the statement in response to a press report regarding a proposed reorganisation of entities controlled by PTIC.
Chengdu Telecom said it had not been notified by PTIC of the proposed reorganisation.
Trading in the company shares, which was suspended on Wednesday, is due to resume on Thursday.
